name: Sreechem Resins Limited
about: Sreechem Resins Limited manufactures and sells phenol-based resins and other allied products in India. The company offers refractory resin, including magnesia carbon, alumina carbon, dolomite, phenolic, and continuous casting refractories, as well as specialty chemicals. Its products are used in residential, commercial, and industrial applications. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Kolkata, India.
